content.text: Section 12.3 expressly negates any exclusivity binding us, and 12.4 runs in our favor. No redline needed.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, meeting the preferred position. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer may engage any supplier and has given no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC or minimum-volume commitment, and clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. Document-wide searches for "exclusive", "sole", and requirements-purchase language surface only unrelated uses (non-exclusive licence in 13, non-exclusive remedies in 19/21/30, exclusive jurisdiction in 28). Clause 12.4 restricts Vendor from marketing a competing analytics service — exclusivity running in Customer's favour, which the rule treats as acceptable and which we leave intact.
